types.name: Advance
docs: One advance to one validator (seeds: `["advance", vote, seq]`).
Repayment is a flat fee, not interest: `total_due = principal + fee`, and
every sweep remits `remit_bps` of gross revenue until `repaid == total_due`.
Each remittance is attributed to principal and fee pro rata so the pool's
receivable and income ledgers stay exact.

fields.name: lamports_in
docs: SOL the swap used (a partial fill returns the rest to the escrow).

fields.name: fee_free_out
docs: The pool's output for `lamports_in` before fees, from its state at
execution: the protocol's reference for the min-out floor.

fields.name: escrow_balance
docs: Escrow balance above rent after the slice.

types.name: BuybackParams
docs: Buyback parameters the pool admin may change (never the share or the term).

types.name: BuybackVenue
docs: Which Meteora program a buyback slice swapped on (`BuybackExecuted.venue`).

types.name: FeeIndex
docs: The Solana Fee Index (seeds: `["fee_index", pool]`).
The program is its own oracle: a proposal carries a value and the hash of
its inputs, anyone can finalize it after `dispute_window_slots`, and the
admin can veto inside the window. A proposal that moves more than
`max_move_bps` from the last finalized value is rejected outright.
Readers take `value`/`epoch` directly; a CPI read is `get_sfi`.
Who proposes: `publisher`. With operator consensus on, `publisher` is the
`IndexOperators` PDA (no key can sign for it), and proposals come from
`IndexBallot`s that reached consensus, or from `post_index` by the sole
operator of a one-operator registry. The layout is unchanged.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Last finalized point.

fields.name: has_proposal
docs: Pending proposal, valid when `has_proposal`.

types.name: FeeQuote
docs: A market maker's fixed-rate quote for one epoch of the Fee Index
(seeds: `["quote", maker, epoch]`). The maker's collateral sits on this
account above its rent; each open swap locks the maker's maximum loss.

fields.name: fixed_rate
docs: Fixed index level the maker will settle against.

fields.name: max_move_bps
docs: Payoff is clipped to ±`max_move_bps` of notional, so collateral on
both sides is exactly `notional × max_move_bps / 10_000`.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Maker collateral held on this account (lamports above rent).

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Part of `collateral` locked by open swaps.

types.name: HistoryEntry
docs: One epoch of a validator's record. 128 bytes, every field naturally
aligned. A field still at its type's maximum is unknown.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The epoch this entry describes; `UNKNOWN_U64` for an empty slot.

fields.name: epoch_credits
docs: Vote credits earned in the epoch (final once the epoch is over).

fields.name: max_credits
docs: Slots in the epoch × 16: the timely-vote-credit maximum.

fields.name: vote_lamports
docs: Vote-account lamports at the latest copy in the epoch.

fields.name: revenue_lamports
docs: Revenue by the sweep rule: the most seen above the sweep floor (rent +
pending delegator rewards) in the vote account plus the escrow above
rent, over the epoch's copies. It includes rewards for the previous
epoch that land early in this one.

fields.name: mev_earned_lamports
docs: The tip-distribution merkle root's `max_total_claim`: every lamport of
MEV tips the epoch pays out (stakers plus the validator's commission).

fields.name: priority_fees_lamports
docs: Lamports the validator sent to its priority-fee distribution account.

fields.name: activated_stake_lamports
docs: Oracle: activated stake.

fields.name: last_voted_slot
docs: Slot of the newest vote in the tower at the latest copy.

fields.name: updated_slot
docs: Slot of the latest write from any source.

fields.name: rank
docs: Oracle: rank by activated stake (1 = largest).

fields.name: superminority
docs: Oracle: 1 when in the superminority, 0 when not.

fields.name: sources
docs: `SOURCE_*` bits.

types.name: IndexBallot
docs: One epoch's Fee Index vote (seeds: `["index_ballot", fee_index, epoch]`).
Adapted from jito-foundation/jito-tip-router/core/src/ballot_box.rs
(MIT or Apache-2.0): a per-epoch box of operator votes tallied against the
TOTAL registered weight; an operator may change its vote until consensus,
its vote is locked after it, and operators that had not voted may still
vote late for the record. Changed for a numeric index: votes agree when
they fall within `tolerance_bps` of the weighted median instead of being
equal, each vote's deviation is stored, the operator set is snapshotted
into the ballot (no separate snapshot accounts), one fixed account holds
up to eight operators, and a vetoed round reopens in place (`round`).

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent; `close_index_ballot` refunds it.

fields.name: round
docs: 0 for the first round, +1 for every reopening.

fields.name: threshold_bps
docs: Snapshot of the registry when the round opened.

fields.name: median_value
docs: Weighted median of the votes cast; frozen at consensus.

fields.name: agreeing_weight
docs: Weight within the tolerance of the median (of the agreed value after
consensus, late votes included).

fields.name: consensus_slot
docs: 0 until the threshold is met.

fields.name: proposed_slot
docs: Slot the proposal was written into `FeeIndex`; 0 while queued.

types.name: IndexBallotOpened
docs: A ballot round opened (round 0 with the first vote; later rounds after a
veto or an admin reset), with the registry snapshot it votes under.

fields.name: reset
docs: Opened by the admin's `reset_index_ballot` rather than by a vote.

types.name: IndexBallotSubmitted
docs: A queued consensus was written into `FeeIndex` (`IndexProposed` follows).

types.name: IndexConsensusReached
docs: The agreeing weight met the threshold. `proposed`: the value went into
`FeeIndex` in the same instruction (`IndexProposed` follows); otherwise it
is queued for `submit_index_ballot`.

types.name: IndexOperator
docs: One registered Fee Index operator: the key that signs its votes and its
voting weight.

types.name: IndexOperators
docs: The operators that vote on the Solana Fee Index (seeds:
`["index_operators", fee_index]`).
Adapted from jito-foundation/jito-tip-router/program/src/cast_vote.rs
(MIT or Apache-2.0): there the voter is a Jito restaking `Operator.voter`
and its stake weight comes from per-epoch operator snapshots and weight
tables. Epoch has no restaking: the admin registers up to eight voting keys
and their weights here, and each ballot copies this registry when a round
opens, so a change applies from the next round and never moves a vote in
progress.
Creating the registry points `FeeIndex.publisher` at this PDA, which no key
can sign for: from then on a value reaches `FeeIndex` only through a ballot
(or `post_index` by the sole operator of a one-operator registry).

fields.name: threshold_bps
docs: Agreeing weight needed, bps of `total_weight` (rounded-up share).

fields.name: tolerance_bps
docs: A vote agrees when within this many bps of the weighted median.

fields.name: operators
docs: The first `operator_count` entries are used, in the order added.

types.name: IndexOperatorsInitialized
docs: The operator registry was created; `FeeIndex.publisher` is now the
registry PDA, so values come from ballots.

fields.name: value
docs: Stake-weighted median priority fee, micro-lamports per compute unit.

types.name: IndexVote
docs: One operator's slot in a ballot round. `operator` and `weight` are copied
from the registry when the round opens; the rest is its vote.

fields.name: value
docs: µL/CU, as `post_index`'s `value`.

fields.name: slot
docs: Slot of the operator's latest vote this round.

fields.name: deviation_bps
docs: Distance from the weighted median before consensus, from the agreed
value after it; bps rounded up (`math::consensus::deviation_bps`).

fields.name: agrees
docs: Within the tolerance of that same reference value.

fields.name: late
docs: Cast after consensus: on the record, never counted.

types.name: IndexVoteCast
docs: One operator's vote. `deviation_bps` and `agrees` are against the median
after this vote (against the agreed value for a late vote); the tally
fields are the round's after this vote.

fields.name: changed
docs: Replaced the operator's earlier vote this round.

fields.name: late
docs: Cast after consensus: recorded, never counted.

types.name: LenderShares
docs: A lender's share balance in one tranche (seeds: `["lender", pool, owner, tranche]`).
Shares are an internal ledger, not SPL tokens, so no token program is
involved and a transfer of shares is not possible without going through
the withdrawal queue.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares the lender can request to withdraw.

fields.name: pending_shares
docs: Shares locked in open withdrawal requests.

fields.name: last_deposit_epoch
docs: Epoch of the most recent deposit; junior lock counts from here.

types.name: Pool
docs: The lending pool. One per deployment (seeds: `["pool"]`).
Ledger invariant, checked by `assert_ledger`:
`senior_assets + junior_assets + income_unallocated == cash + outstanding_principal`
and the vault holds at least `cash + bond_total + rent`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives the protocol fee.

fields.name: scorer
docs: May post Epoch Scores.

fields.name: cash
docs: Lamports in the vault that belong to lenders (excludes bonds and rent).

fields.name: outstanding_principal
docs: Principal lent out and not yet repaid.

fields.name: expected_fees
docs: Fees contracted on open advances and not yet received.

fields.name: income_unallocated
docs: Fee income received and not yet split between tranches.

fields.name: bond_total
docs: Validator bonds held in the vault (not lender money).

fields.name: senior_pending_shares
docs: Shares queued for withdrawal, per tranche, so new advances do not
starve queued withdrawals.

types.name: PoolParams
docs: Governance-set parameters. Every rate is in basis points.

fields.name: senior_rate_bps_per_epoch
docs: Senior tranche target coupon per epoch (3 = 0.03%/epoch ≈ 8.1%/yr at ≈271.5 epochs a year).

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Share of realised income (fees and recoveries) paid to the treasury.

fields.name: advance_bps_unhedged
docs: Credit limit as a share of trailing-window revenue, unhedged validators.

fields.name: advance_bps_hedged
docs: Same, for validators hedged on the Fee Market.

fields.name: bond_multiplier
docs: Credit limit cap as a multiple of the posted bond. 0 disables the bond cap.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Flat fee on principal charged at origination (200 = 2%).

fields.name: remit_bps
docs: Share of each epoch's swept revenue that goes to repayment.

fields.name: min_score
docs: Minimum Epoch Score to borrow (0..=10,000).

fields.name: score_ttl_epochs
docs: A score older than this many epochs is stale.

fields.name: min_advance_lamports
docs: Smallest advance, lamports.

fields.name: max_advance_lamports
docs: Largest advance per validator, lamports.

fields.name: max_pool_assets
docs: Cap on total lender assets, lamports. 0 = uncapped.

fields.name: max_utilization_bps
docs: Outstanding principal may not exceed this share of total assets.

fields.name: min_junior_bps
docs: Junior assets must stay at or above this share of total assets.

fields.name: junior_lock_epochs
docs: Epochs a junior deposit is locked before it can be withdrawn.

fields.name: max_advance_epochs
docs: An advance older than this is defaultable even if revenue keeps arriving.

fields.name: vote_reserve_lamports
docs: Lamports left in the vote account on every sweep for the admission
ticket and vote fees (SIMD-0357 VAT).

fields.name: min_commission_bps
docs: Validators may not set commission below this while onboarded.

types.name: QuoteWithdrawn
docs: `withdraw_quote` closed the quote: `lamports` (collateral left plus rent) went back to the maker.

types.name: RevenueShareSwept
docs: The revenue share a sweep moved into the buyback escrow (emitted next to
`Swept`, whose `gross` includes it).

fields.name: after_senior_advance
docs: The share came after a pre-registration advance's remittance.

fields.name: escrow_balance
docs: Escrow balance above rent after the sweep.

types.name: RevenueToken
docs: A validator's revenue token (seeds: `["revenue_token", vote]`).
The validator sold `share_bps` of its gross revenue for `term_epochs`
epochs as an SPL token launched on a Meteora DBC curve. Every sweep in the
term moves the share into the buyback escrow `["buyback", vote]`; buyback
slices swap it for the token and burn what they buy; after the term (or
during it, when the admin allows), holders can `redeem` tokens for a
pro-rata share of whatever the escrow still holds.

fields.name: position
docs: The `ValidatorPosition` it was registered on (may be closed after the term).

fields.name: operator
docs: Paid the rent at registration; receives it back from `close_revenue_token`.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Always SPL Token in v1 (Token-2022 mints are rejected at registration).

fields.name: damm_pool
docs: The DAMM v2 pool the curve graduated to; all zeros until
`sync_revenue_token_pool` verifies and records it.

fields.name: start_epoch
docs: First epoch whose sweep pays the share (the epoch after registration).

fields.name: term_end_epoch
docs: `start_epoch + term_epochs`: the first epoch after the term. Release and
commission cuts are blocked until then.

fields.name: advance_seq_at_registration
docs: `position.advance_seq` at registration. An advance with a lower `seq`
predates the token and keeps its claim on gross revenue: while it is
open the share is taken after its remittance, not before.

fields.name: inflation_commission_bps
docs: Vote-account commission at registration; neither may go lower during the term.

fields.name: window_slots
docs: Slots from the start of the epoch during which slices may run.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
docs: `min_amount_out` must be at least the pool's fee-free output minus this.

fields.name: max_impact_bps
docs: One slice may move the pool price by at most this much.

fields.name: flags
docs: `FLAG_BUYBACKS_PAUSED | FLAG_REDEEM_DURING_TERM`.

fields.name: buyback_epoch
docs: Epoch the fields below belong to.

fields.name: epoch_budget
docs: Escrow balance (above rent) when the epoch's first slice ran.

fields.name: slices_done
docs: Bit `i` set = slice `i` ran in `buyback_epoch`.

fields.name: last_share_epoch
docs: Epoch of the last sweep that ran with this token attached.

fields.name: total_escrowed
docs: Shares swept into the escrow.

fields.name: total_spent
docs: SOL spent on buybacks.

fields.name: total_bought
docs: Tokens the buybacks received.

fields.name: total_burned
docs: Tokens burned by the buybacks (what they bought plus anything else
sent to the buyback token account).

fields.name: total_redeemed
docs: Tokens burned by `redeem`, and the SOL paid for them.

fields.name: fee_floor_bps
docs: The lowest fee, bps, the token's venues can charge (the DBC curve's
floor or the graduated DAMM v2 pool's fee, from the DBC config at
registration). `max_impact_bps` may not exceed twice it.

fields.name: lamports_to_pool
docs: Escrow left unclaimed after the redemption grace period, booked as
pool income (0 when the escrow was spent). Appended: older decoders
that ignore trailing bytes still read the fields above.

types.name: RevenueTokenStatus
docs: Where the token trades, so where buybacks swap.

types.name: ScoreConfig
docs: Governance settings for `refresh_score` (seeds: `["score_config", pool]`).

fields.name: market_maker
docs: Epoch's market maker: only swaps against its quotes count as a hedge
(`post_quote` is open to any key). Default: nobody is hedged.

fields.name: credits_window_epochs
docs: Finished epochs the credits ratio and the commission look back over.

fields.name: count_block_commission
docs: Count the vote account's block-revenue commission (turn on once
SIMD-0123 makes it binding).

fields.name: credits_reference_bps
docs: Credits ÷ TVC maximum, bps, that scores as the cluster average.

fields.name: max_copy_age_slots
docs: The vote copy `refresh_score` uses must be at most this many slots old.

types.name: ScoreRefreshed
docs: `refresh_score` also emits `ScoreUpdated`, so score consumers need no change.

fields.name: credits_ratio_bps
docs: Credits ratio on the score's scale (10,000 = the cluster reference).

fields.name: credits_ratio_raw_bps
docs: Credits ÷ TVC maximum over the window, bps.

types.name: ScoreUpdate
docs: Inputs the scorer posts each epoch. The formula is on-chain
(`math::score`), so the score is reproducible from these numbers. This is
the fallback for clusters without validator history: once a validator's
history is fresh, `refresh_score` computes the inputs on chain and this
instruction refuses (`HistoryIsFresh`).

fields.name: credits_ratio_bps
docs: Vote credits as a share of the cluster average, bps.

fields.name: commission_bps
docs: The higher of inflation and MEV commission, bps.

fields.name: hedged
docs: The validator holds a Fee Market hedge for the coming epoch.

types.name: ScoringParams
docs: Settings for `refresh_score`; see `ScoreConfig`.

types.name: SwapPosition
docs: A taker's side of one quote (seeds: `["swap", quote, taker]`). The taker's
collateral sits on this account above its rent until settlement.

fields.name: pnl
docs: Taker's realised profit (positive) or loss (negative), lamports.

fields.name: from_vote
docs: Withdrawn from the vote account this sweep.

fields.name: gross
docs: Total gross revenue processed (vote withdrawal + collector deposits).

fields.name: found
docs: False when the account does not exist (no Jito, or not created yet).

fields.name: mev_earned_lamports
docs: `max_total_claim` once the merkle root is uploaded.

types.name: Tranche
docs: The two lender tranches. Senior is paid first and takes losses last.

types.name: TreasuryClaimKind
docs: What a treasury claim collected (`TreasuryClaimed.kind`).

types.name: TreasuryClaimed
docs: The partner treasury claimed from Meteora. SOL went to the vault as pool
income (`income_unallocated`, paid out at the next `accrue`: protocol fee,
senior coupon, then junior); tokens were burned.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token (DBC base mint / DAMM v2 token A).

fields.name: source
docs: The DBC pool, or the DAMM v2 pool for `LpFee`.

fields.name: position
docs: The DAMM v2 position for `LpFee`, the default key otherwise.

fields.name: lamports_claimed
docs: Wrapped SOL Meteora paid to the treasury.

fields.name: lamports_to_pool
docs: Lamports added to the pool's cash and income (the claim plus anything
already sitting on the claim account's address).

fields.name: tokens_claimed
docs: Tokens Meteora paid to the treasury.

fields.name: tokens_burned
docs: Tokens burned: the claim plus anything already in the treasury's
token account.

fields.name: pool_cash
docs: The pool's cash and undistributed income after the claim.

types.name: ValidatorHistory
docs: A validator's on-chain record (seeds: `["history", vote]`). Anyone may
create it and copy chain state into it; only `update_stake_info` (the
pool's scorer) writes oracle fields.

fields.name: last_vote_copy_slot
docs: Slot of the latest `copy_vote_account`.

fields.name: refreshed_epoch
docs: Epoch and slot of the latest `refresh_score` (0 = never).

fields.name: hedge_required_notional
docs: Receive-fixed notional the hedge rule required at the last refresh.

fields.name: epochs_voted
docs: Epochs with credits in the vote account's own history (≤ 64) at the
latest copy.

fields.name: credits_ratio_bps
docs: Credits ratio on the score's scale (10,000 = the cluster reference).

fields.name: credits_ratio_raw_bps
docs: Credits earned ÷ the TVC maximum over the window, bps.

fields.name: score_flags
docs: `SCORE_FLAG_*` bits.

fields.name: entries
docs: Entry for epoch `e` lives at `e % HISTORY_LEN`.

types.name: ValidatorPosition
docs: One onboarded validator (seeds: `["position", vote]`).
The program's PDA `["vote_auth", vote]` is the vote account's withdraw
authority for as long as this position exists, and `["escrow", vote]` is
the system-owned account both commission collectors point at.

fields.name: identity
docs: Validator identity (node pubkey) at onboarding. Locked while an
advance is open because `UpdateValidatorIdentity` resets the block
revenue collector.

fields.name: operator
docs: Signs operator actions: advances, commission changes, release.

fields.name: payout
docs: Receives the validator's share of every sweep.

fields.name: original_withdrawer
docs: Withdraw authority before onboarding; the default target of `release`.

fields.name: hedged
docs: Set by the scorer when the validator holds a fee hedge for the epoch.

fields.name: revenue_count
docs: Number of filled slots, capped at `REVENUE_WINDOW`.

fields.name: bond_lamports
docs: Lamports the operator posted as a bond; held in the pool vault.

fields.name: advance_seq
docs: Monotonic; part of every advance's seeds.

fields.name: late_epochs
docs: Consecutive swept epochs with zero revenue while an advance is open.

fields.name: revenue_token
docs: The validator's `RevenueToken` (`["revenue_token", vote]`), or all
zeros for none. Takes the 32 bytes that were `_reserved`, so the
account size (415) and every other field are unchanged, and positions
onboarded before revenue tokens existed read as "none".

fields.name: epoch_credits
docs: Credits earned so far in `epoch`.

fields.name: epochs_backfilled
docs: Epochs of credits written from the vote account's own history.

fields.name: last_voted_slot
docs: `None` for an empty tower.

fields.name: revenue_lamports
docs: The epoch's revenue entry after this copy (sweep rule).

types.name: WithdrawCancelled
docs: `reason`: 0 = cancelled by the owner, 1 = bounced by the junior floor
when it reached the head of the queue (shares returned to the owner).

types.name: WithdrawRequest
docs: A queued withdrawal (seeds: `["withdraw", pool, seq]`). Requests are paid
strictly in `seq` order, whole-or-nothing, at the share price on the day
they are processed. That keeps a run fair: nobody jumps the queue and the
queue never pays out cash that an earlier request is waiting for.
